newsitem.title: UK: BoE says Davies will step down to head up SIB.
newsitem.headline: BoE says Davies will step down to head up SIB.

text.p: Deputy Bank of England Governor Howard Davies will drop his role at the Bank to take up his role as the head of Britain's new, improved Securities and Investment Board.
"He will stand down as deputy governor, probably when the legislation regarding the new system has been passed," a Bank spokeswoman said.

Earlier, Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown told Parliament that supervision of Britain's banking sector would be transferred to a new, strengthened Securities and Investment Board from the Bank.
The enhanced SIB will also take responsibility for the regulatory regime covered by the Financial Services Act and Davies will head it.
Brown said two new deputy governors of the Bank will be appointed in due course, to sit as part of the nine-member team of Britain's new monetary policy committee.
